WITH base AS (SELECT NULLIF(btrim($1::text), '') AS tok)
SELECT p.id, p.title, p.baseline_status, p.baseline_approval_token AS token,
       p.baseline_approved_by, p.baseline_approved_at,
       e.division_code, e.scope_description, e.allocated_amount,
       (p.id IS NOT NULL) AS found
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.baseline_approval_token::text = b.tok
  LEFT JOIN estimates e ON e.project_id = p.id
 ORDER BY e.division_code;

WITH proj AS (SELECT id FROM projects WHERE baseline_approval_token::text = $1 AND baseline_status = 'SENT' FOR UPDATE), approved AS (UPDATE projects p SET baseline_status = CASE WHEN $2 = 'approve' THEN 'APPROVED' ELSE 'REJECTED' END, baseline_approved_at = CASE WHEN $2 = 'approve' THEN now() ELSE NULL END, baseline_approved_by = 'customer', baseline_approval_method = $3, baseline_signer_name = $4, original_contract_value = CASE WHEN $2 = 'approve' THEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(allocated_amount), 0.00) FROM estimates e WHERE e.project_id = p.id) ELSE p.original_contract_value END, revised_contract_value = CASE WHEN $2 = 'approve' THEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(allocated_amount), 0.00) FROM estimates e WHERE e.project_id = p.id) ELSE p.revised_contract_value END FROM proj WHERE p.id = proj.id RETURNING p.id, p.title, p.original_contract_value, p.revised_contract_value, p.baseline_status) SELECT * FROM approved;

SELECT co.id, co.change_order_number, co.description, co.cost_impact, co.approval_status, co.approval_token AS token, p.title AS project_name FROM change_orders co JOIN projects p ON p.id = co.project_id WHERE co.approval_token::text = $1 LIMIT 1;

WITH co AS (SELECT id, project_id FROM change_orders WHERE approval_token::text = $1 AND approval_status = 'PENDING' FOR UPDATE), decided AS (UPDATE change_orders c SET approval_status = CASE WHEN $2 = 'approve' THEN 'APPROVED' ELSE 'REJECTED' END, approved_at = CASE WHEN $2 = 'approve' THEN now() ELSE NULL END, approved_by = 'customer', approval_method = $3, signer_name = $4 FROM co WHERE c.id = co.id RETURNING c.project_id, c.change_order_number, c.cost_impact, c.approval_status), recalc AS (UPDATE projects p SET revised_contract_value = p.original_contract_value + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c2.cost_impact), 0.00) FROM change_orders c2 WHERE c2.project_id = p.id AND c2.approval_status = 'APPROVED') + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.cost_impact), 0.00) FROM decided d WHERE d.project_id = p.id AND d.approval_status = 'APPROVED') WHERE p.id IN (SELECT project_id FROM decided) RETURNING p.id, p.title, p.revised_contract_value) SELECT d.change_order_number, d.cost_impact, d.approval_status, r.title, r.revised_contract_value FROM decided d JOIN recalc r ON r.id = d.project_id;
SELECT token FROM device_tokens UNION ALL SELECT NULL::text WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_tokens);
